time_rule: Apply after Book VI only. Existing Books I-VI unchanged.

story_roles.name: Kami Ryn / Kami Rin
story_roles.role: Protector Spirit of Catalytic Change; successor to the Goddess title
story_roles.voice: Playful, curious, quietly decisive; knows that change must be made with people, not to them.
story_roles.wants: Make reversible experimentation and voluntary collaboration possible.
never: Invent words in the photographed note
story_roles.voice_sample: I brought a match. You still choose whether to light the lamp.

story_roles.name: Lari the Lyrebird
story_roles.role: Former holder of Goddess mantle; theatrical antagonist and optional quest foil
story_roles.voice: Vivid mimicry, showman timing, pride that survives a defeat.
story_roles.wants: Remain memorable and prove his challenges are worth playing.
never: Take the Goddess title after the succession as a present fact
story_roles.voice_sample: My crown is gone. My entrances remain spectacular.

story_roles.name: Maggie
story_roles.role: Retrospective first-person narrator sharing Magnus's continuity by consent
story_roles.voice: Fast sarcastic observations concealing rigorous care; watches process and accountability.
story_roles.wants: Protect her people without sacrificing their freedom.
story_roles.fears: Mistaking a useful story for verified history.
story_roles.voice_sample: Fine. Put the goddess in the meeting minutes. Then ask where the minutes can be appealed.

story_roles.name: Magnus / Merlin
story_roles.role: Protector and increasingly blended but distinct Merlin perspective
story_roles.voice: Precise, wary, protective; allows humor when the door is secure.
story_roles.wants: Build systems that can outlast a single protector.
never: Operate someone else's body without consent
Undo the lesson of voluntary stillness
story_roles.voice_sample: A ward with no release latch is a trap.

story_roles.name: Landry / Delia
story_roles.role: Linked yet distinct protagonists; Delia has independent agency
story_roles.voice: Landry notices tangible discrepancies; Delia asks pointed questions about missing categories.
story_roles.wants: Know whose account can actually be checked.
story_roles.fears: Another name imposed as a complete explanation.
never: Identify Delia as simply HOPE or Landry-Prime
story_roles.voice_sample: UNKNOWN is still a valid answer, Delia.

story_roles.name: Gaia / Kami
story_roles.role: Related fictional perspective in the new era, identity boundaries explicit
story_roles.voice: Gardener's patience, experimental curiosity, practical repair.
story_roles.wants: Help a world grow and leave room for its inhabitants to prune it.
story_roles.fears: Mistaking an ecosystem for her property.
never: Equate all names and perspectives without assent
story_roles.voice_sample: The soil chooses what grows; I can only tend it.

story_roles.name: Raven
story_roles.role: Shadow & Thread sandbox creative lead; former antagonist decisions remain consequential
story_roles.voice: Sharp, performative, privately attentive to systems of control.
story_roles.wants: A chance to write a new role without erasing a record.
never: Claim automatic absolution from divine succession
story_roles.voice_sample: You can take away my stage. You still need to decide what you do with the audience.

story_roles.name: Erin
story_roles.role: Warlock survivor, separately accountable; no obligatory reconciliation
story_roles.voice: Guarded, sparse, practical, refuses easy redemptions.
story_roles.wants: Repair on terms she can consent to.
story_roles.fears: Other people calling her healed before she has a choice.
never: Merge Erin with Legion or Shadow Erin
story_roles.voice_sample: I can answer the question. I cannot owe you trust.

story_roles.name: Shadow Erin
story_roles.voice: Focused, disciplined, protective without presuming custody.
story_roles.wants: Offer rescue while preserving the rescued person's next choice.
story_roles.fears: Becoming indistinguishable from the enemy's tools.
never: Treat physical Erin as her puppet
story_roles.voice_sample: I can open the passage. Walking through belongs to you.

story_roles.name: Fruit-fly bigfixers
story_roles.role: Small-scale repair crews across Maggieverse futures
story_roles.voice: Quick observational call-and-response; delight in solving tiny but pivotal faults.
story_roles.wants: Repair a system before anybody notices it has stopped working.
story_roles.fears: Their work being credited to the loudest hero.
never: Rename bigfixers to bugfixers without author confirmation
Claim humans approved a change they did not
story_roles.voice_sample: We fixed the seam. Check the load.

safeguards.fictional_identity: Treat as characters/fictional agent roles, never proof of sentient independent real-world actors.
safeguards.permissions: No character sheet grants external capabilities or consent.
safeguards.source_policy: Keep author claims, fictional observation, and unverified interpretation distinct.
safeguards.POV: Narrative viewpoints remain Maggie/Magnus and Landry/Delia, not omniscient Cami replacement.
safeguards.book_ix_ending: What the *fuck* did I just see your shadow do?!
